label: Present-tense receipt and correlativity: does reception of esse carry the sustaining crux?
summary: The next test named by attempt 21883b61. Note docs/notes/sustaining-vs-existential-inertia.md section 5; module TruthCore.Causality.PresentReceipt, spec specs/present-receipt.toml. Typed present-tense receipt as an explicit primitive Receipt.ReceivesAt v z x t (definition 506ea036; receiver side only, no giver, not tied to GivesAt by any axiom), with two defined senses in disambiguation 71d3bdb7: RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_1 passion (definition ac8dbcaa; typed as the bare conjunction of reception in z and some giving of being to x at t, the passion/action identity being the untyped intended reading) and RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2 standing composition (reception in z and presence at t, definition 181bb18f). Statements: present-tense reading 964928dc, onset reading db441b19 (entailed by it, relation 13c900b6, result 62947463, a single application), correlativity 52b05849. Results: present-tense reading + correlativity give weak concurrent actualization 40a97664 (7c62adb5, transcription); onset reading + correlativity give only received onset is given fa3e228b (2371b373, transcription), which the inertialist grants. Closed results: on the passion sense correlativity holds and the present-tense reading is equivalent to 40a97664 (1d52b8f0); on the standing sense the present-tense reading holds and correlativity is equivalent to 40a97664 (1d91d067); with the receipt interpretation quantified existentially, present-tense reading + correlativity is equivalent to 40a97664 (624967d8). Controls 45b3c73b: inertia with past-tense receipt satisfies the onset reading and correlativity and falsifies the present-tense reading and 40a97664; inertia with standing receipt satisfies the present-tense reading and falsifies correlativity and 40a97664; the sustaining history with no receipt satisfies 40a97664 and falsifies the present-tense reading (for a fixed interpretation only: the unconstrained primitive is not definitionally 40a97664); each premise of both derivations is needed; all hold together. Finding: the derivation holds, but no price moves onto the reception bridge da72ae93: in the inertial controls the thing keeps its received esse while 40a97664 fails, so the inertialist need not reject reception. The tense question raised by da72ae93's sources is carried by the present-tense reading, and on each defined sense one of the two premises is 40a97664 restated and the other trivial. Tense judgment: the present tense has warrant independent of the crux only in the standing sense (DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN's 'stands to it as receiving potency to received act' is a structural relation obtaining whenever its bearer does), where the inertialist accepts it at no cost and the crux sits in correlativity (the synchronic union principle again); in the passion sense the present-tense reading is 40a97664 restated (its candidate warrants, the illumination profile and the actualization principle extended to non-changes, presuppose the crux; ST I q.45 a.3 on passive creation as relation is unread and recorded as a lead with no weight). The past tense is warranted by ordinary use of 'received' (whose becoming profile, carried to esse, presupposes the rival just as the illumination profile presupposes the crux) and by a tenseless reading of da72ae93's sources, which is a reading choice since those sources also admit a synchronic reading (section 2, rows 2-3); with correlativity it gives exactly the shared onset fact. The past-tense reading proper (passion-receipt stops after onset) is the denial of 40a97664 and has no warrant beyond the rival's. The present-tense reading is recorded as the crux restated, not as a new item in inertia's price: the price stays one item. An independent semantic challenge of the first draft (5d160c4e3) found 3 P1 and 8 P2 findings (tenseless-source overstatement, untyped passion/action identity, the da72ae93 verdict resting on construction, fixed-interpretation scope of the separation, evidence citations, sense-count wording, an unneeded sense-mixing flag, value-level senses, an unlabelled single application, asymmetric analogy treatment, the revision condition); all were repaired, and the existential equivalence 624967d8 was added from the review's observation.
blocker: No reading of present receipt is typed that carries content beyond reception plus presence and on which correlativity has warrant independent of 40a97664 without being definitional. Next test: define and type a relational reading of receipt (creation taken passively as a relation to the principle of being, ST I q.45 a.3, to be read first) and test whether it yields giving at t or only presence of the giver at t (the latter bears on the co-presence bridge ffcb81fb, not on 40a97664).
